title: Scene (qwen/lora_dataset/scene.json)
description: Background and lighting slots for Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 dataset rows. Empty or omitted patterns emit one row without that axis.

patterns.description: One generated row per pattern, after art style in the cartesian product. Joined before camera in the edit instruction and caption.

prompt.description: Short natural-language slot joined into the edit instruction and caption. Not a full sentence and not Danbooru tags (e.g. in an indoor kitchen, under soft daylight).
